IUCN status: **Endangered**

### Studies in support

No studies

### Studies not in support

No studies

### Is the threat claim evidence-based?

No studies were found linking cats to northern hopping mice.
<br>
<br>

![**Evidence linking *Notomys aquilo* to cats.** Systematic review of evidence for an association between *Notomys aquilo* and cats. Positive studies are in support of the hypothesis that *cats* contribute to the decline of Notomys aquilo, negative studies are not in support. Predation studies include studies documenting hunting or scavenging; baiting studies are associations between poison baiting and threatened mammal abundance where information on predator abundance is not provided; population studies are associations between threatened mammal and predator abundance. Gold borders indicate studies that meet qualities of scientific rigour. See methods section in Wallach and Lundgren 2025 for details on evidence categories.](assets/figures/Main_Evidence_Cat_Notomys aquilo.png)
